_comment: Single source of truth for the deployed live-edge base URL, added after the workers.dev subdomain was operator-renamed mid-session (old ferrum-os.shariefsatyala.workers.dev prefix killed, ferrumos-preview.shariefsatyala.workers.dev is current) and broke every hardcoded-URL audit script/battery in one shot. Any script/battery that hits the live edge should resolve its base URL from here (or the FERRUM_LIVE_BASE_URL env var, which takes precedence) instead of a literal string, so a future rename is a one-line edit here, not a grep-and-replace across every script.

history.note: operator-killed 2026-09-05; returns Cloudflare error 1042 on every route
